description: This file defines a React functional component 'KeywordTable' that renders a table of blocked keywords, allowing users to change actions (BLOCK or MASK) and delete entries. It includes TypeScript interfaces for props and data items, and uses Ant Design components along with Tremor UI elements.

classes.name: BlockedWord
classes.description: Interface representing a blocked keyword with optional description and action type (BLOCK or MASK).

classes.name: KeywordTableProps
classes.description: Props for the KeywordTable component, including keywords array, action change handler, and remove handler.

methods.name: KeywordTable
methods.description: React functional component rendering a table of keywords with controls to change actions and delete entries.
